blocker.statement: Browser-editable settings.url_base selects the classic recipient of the stored secret. A naive server relay leaks it to a destination chosen by an authenticated administrator.
decisionRequired: Define server-owned trusted destinations, or an approved outbound-origin allowlist independent of browser-controlled settings, including redirect policy.
Accredit the classic receiver authentication contract and coordinate server-only secret use and later rotation.
blocker.stopReason: User explicitly requires stopping and documenting ambiguous dependencies before implementation.
